sources.credit: UK National Commission for UNESCO photo, reference only.
sources.observation: The surviving grassy bank and wide U-shaped ditch have rounded crests. A shallow outer scarp follows the ditch.

sources.credit: Gunther Tschuch via Wikimedia Commons, reference only.
sources.observation: Staggered rows of shallow oval depressions occupy a small grassy clearing north of the ditch.

sources.credit: Wikimedia Commons topographic image, reference only.
sources.observation: Multiple low scarps enclose the fort and annexe on the south side of the main ditch. The natural stream valley breaks the line on the west.

limitations: Coverage is the visible Rough Castle segment only. The earthwork cross-sections and individual pit positions use photo-based estimates from their mapped areas. The model represents the surviving landforms.
